{{Quote|Master ''Shon-Ju''&mdash;the Jedi! She's in bad shape.|The male force user to Shon-Ju|<ref name="Shon-Ju" />}}
A muscular [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Force user''' was a [[Shon-Ju's Force school|student]] of the rogue former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Shon-Ju]]<ref name="Shon-Ju" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' establishes that ''The Clone Wars'' takes place in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]</ref> Shon-Ju had been rejected from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and spent time in exile, learning new ways to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Shon-Ju then took this [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] and [[Unidentified Ithorian (Force student)|two]] [[Unidentified Zabrak (Force user)|other]] students and taught them to channel the Force through their [[hand]]s.<ref name="Shon-Ju" />

In 21 BBY, Shon-Ju and his students pursued the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Attuma Duum]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Cavamina Minor]] in order to stop his crimes. The Jedi Order had also sent [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] to stop Duum. Secura was forced to flee Duum's forces and crash-landed on Cavamina Minor. Shon-Ju and his students assisted Secura by directly engaging Duum's mercenaries in combat; this man grabbed Secura when she tried to flee. After Shon-Ju and his students forcing Duum's men to flee, Secura collapsed from her injuries; this man informed Shon-Ju she was injured. They went back to [[Shon-Ju's castle|Shon-Ju's hideout]]. When the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Jedi awoke, she was alone. She found Shon-Ju overlooking his students' training and questioned him about his life. Down below, Shon-Ju's students practiced channeling the Force by striking a large rock as part of their training.<ref name="Shon-Ju" />

Secura and Shon-Ju agreed to join forces and [[Battle of Cavamina Minor|stop Duum]]. Although they destroyed Duum's operation, Shon-Ju betrayed Secura but was injured and forced to flee.<ref name="Shon-Ju" />

==Personality and traits==
This student was trained in a particular way and was able to focus the Force in combat. Shon-Ju said his students were learning as much from him as he was from them. He wore [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi-style robes]].<ref name="Shon-Ju" />

==Behind the scenes==
This male Force-user appears in the [[2010]] graphic novella ''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''.
